subject: POC Onboarding Playbook — API tokens, org seed, IP allowlist & VPC peering cadence
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@medilytics.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: network@medilytics.com
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — POC environment and MAP details

Hi Sergio,

Thanks again for the demo last week — Medilytics is excited to move to a short POC to validate latency and cost for our triaged clinical use-cases. Before we lock dates I want to confirm a clear onboarding checklist so our infra team can scope the work. High-level asks:

- Org creation / seed users for our team (we'll need an owner and 2 service accounts)
- API key generation and guidance on ephemeral tokens / rotation cadence
- IP allowlist (we have strict egress rules) — I'll attach our network maintenance window
- VPC peering (outline of required firewall ports and peering template)

Can you share a mutual action plan with owners and suggested target dates? Our target is a 2-week ramp from org/keys -> peering -> test run, ideally starting next Monday (11/9). If peering requires a longer procurement window, call that out.

Network contact is network@medilytics.com (cc'd).

Appreciate a concise playbook we can hand to our engineers.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Green | Head of Integrations, Medilytics
Attachment: medilytics_network_window.txt (TXT, 2KB)

From: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
To: Alex Green <alex.green@medilytics.com>
Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick sync — POC environment and MAP details

Alex — thanks, this is a great starting point. I put together a short POC operations playbook and a draft MAP that maps each item to owners and target dates. Attaching: redwood_map_playbook_v1.pdf and a VPC peering template. Key notes below (high level):

POC operations summary (proposed cadence)
- Day 0 (11/09): Redwood creates org tenant and seeds 1 owner account + 2 service accounts. (Owner: Sergio Alvarez)
- Day 1 (11/10): Issue ephemeral API keys (short-lived tokens) + instructions for rotation. (Owner: Marissa Cole)
- Day 2-4 (11/11-11/13): IP allowlist validation and firewall rule confirmation with Medilytics network. (Owner: Medilytics network)
- Day 5-7 (11/15-11/17): VPC peering window (tentative) — we recommend a maintenance slot for cross-team runbook. (Owner: Medilytics network + Redwood infra)
- Day 8-12 (11/18-11/22): Test run, workload exercise, latency/cost capture, and regression checks. (Owner: Medilytics + Redwood)

Security & token guidance
- We recommend short-lived API tokens (1 hour) backed by a service account and automated rotation. If you require longer lived creds, we can provide scoped tokens and strict egress ACLs.

Next steps
1) Please confirm you can accept the proposed Day 0 start on 2026-11-09.
2) Network: can you confirm an available peering window between 11/15–11/18? If not, provide earliest available date.
3) I'll schedule a 30-minute ops handoff with your network engineer after we confirm dates.

Quick MAP (excerpt)
- Org seed: Redwood (Sergio) — target 11/09
- API keys / ephemeral tokens: Redwood (Marissa) — target 11/10
- IP allowlist validation: Medilytics (network@medilytics.com) — target 11/11
- VPC peering: joint — target 11/15

Attachment: redwood_map_playbook_v1.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)
Attachment: vpc_peering_template.txt (TXT, 3KB)

From: Alex Green <alex.green@medilytics.com>
To: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai
Cc: network@medilytics.com, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Nov 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Onboarding Playbook — API tokens, org seed, IP allowlist & VPC peering cadence

Thanks, Sergio — that looks sensible. Two quick clarifications from our side:

1) Ephemeral token model — we prefer 1-hour tokens with automated rotation. Will Redwood provide a sample rotation script or an SDK helper?
2) For VPC peering, our security team prefers minimum privilege: only the peering routes required for inference traffic and no shared DNS resolution. Can you confirm your template supports route-level restrictions?

Network confirms a maintenance window on 11/15 between 02:00–06:00 UTC. They asked if Redwood can provision the service account in advance so we can complete firewall rules ahead of the peering slot. Contact: Jordan Park (network@medilytics.com).

If you can provide the rotation script and confirm route scoping, we can lock the 11/09 start and the 11/15 peering.

Thanks — looping in Marissa for token provisioning and Neha for security signoff.

—Alex

Cc: sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai, neha.kapoor@redwood.ai, network@medilytics.com
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC Onboarding Playbook — final schedule and provisioning tasks

Alex / Jordan — thanks for the confirmations. Quick operational update and firmed schedule from Redwood: 

Confirmed schedule (final)
- 2026-11-09 (Day 0): Org tenant created and owner + 2 service accounts seeded. Action: Sergio (Redwood) — will send org invite and owner confirmation by EOD 11/09.
- 2026-11-10 (Day 1): Ephemeral tokens issued and rotation helper delivered (Python + bash examples). Action: Marissa (Redwood) — token helper will be uploaded to the shared Drive and scoped to service accounts.
- 2026-11-11 (Day 2): Customer to complete IP allowlist validation. Action: Jordan (Medilytics network).
- 2026-11-15 02:00–06:00 UTC: VPC peering window. Action: joint execution — Medilytics to open firewall change ticket early week; Redwood will accept BGP/route confirmation during the window.
- 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-22: Test run and short performance sweep. Redwood will send a lightweight benchmark script to execute standard inference scenarios.

Security notes
- Route scoping: our peering template supports explicit route advertisement/accept lists; we will not enable DNS resolution across the peering by default. Details in vpc_peering_template.txt.
- Token rotation: we will provide a sample rotation script and SDK helper. Tokens will be scoped to the two service accounts and automatically revoked if anomalous usage is detected.

Attachments & links
- redwood_map_playbook_v1.pdf (final internal version)
- vpc_peering_template.txt (peering config + route scoping)
- Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-map-playbook (will upload token helper by 11/10)

Ask from your side
- Please confirm Jordan will raise the firewall change ticket by 11/10 so peering can proceed on 11/15.
- Confirm if you want the token TTL shortened to 30 minutes for POC — Redwood can support shorter windows if preferred.

I'll schedule the 30-minute ops handoff for Monday 11/09 16:00 UTC (or suggest another slot).

Thanks — looking forward to getting the POC running.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
